title: Observe European White Flowers native byte context
changes: Add a bounded test-only native API and DMA observer for three isolated White Flowers byte reads.
validation: Windows build k2ivw3je and Wine unit 95w54vo0 pass: three target bytes are native non-DMA reads in one 600-frame continuation; Wine server drained.
limitations: Exported PC and outer dispatch do not identify the exact instruction; selector domain, source extent, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
